items.a: Zyflow is a route planning app built for cyclists and e-bike riders. It plans cycling routes with automatic charging-stop suggestions, factoring in your battery range, elevation, wind, and temperature so you can ride further with confidence.
Yes. Zyflow is free to download and use on iOS and Android. Beta riders also keep full access at no cost as we grow.
Zyflow works with e-bikes, road, gravel, touring, and mountain bikes. You set your bike type and e-bike range, and we adapt planning to your setup.

items.q: Is Zyflow on iOS and Android?
items.a: Yes. Download from the App Store or Google Play. It only takes a minute.

article.title: why e-bike charging at hospitality stops matters
article.lede: A little preparation goes a long way toward making sure your first long ride is memorable for the right reasons.

body.p1: There’s a particular kind of confidence you only get when you know the next charger isn’t a rumour. If a stop isn’t visible online, many riders never find it. And longer rides shrink to whatever feels safe to guess.
body.p2: The biggest misconception first-timers carry is that “there will be somewhere to plug in.” There often is. But only if you’ve planned for it. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Battery drain swings with elevation and wind, so a map of real hospitality and service stops changes what a day can look like.
body.p3: Before your first cross-border day, check where chargers sit relative to the hardest climbs. It takes a few minutes and can transform the whole experience.
body.h2: plan for the climb, not the cafe

body.li2: Elevation window. Watch where climb clusters sit between known charging stops
body.li3: Weather & wind. Headwinds and cold can reshape the same route overnight

body.h3: start on the right day ride
body.p6: Not all routes are created equal. A rolling countryside day is where almost every rider should start. The rhythm is predictable, and you have time to learn how your battery behaves without the mountains making decisions for you.

hero.storyTitle: It started with a long climb, a flat battery, and a better plan.
hero.storyBody: We’re the small team behind Zyflow. Building smart navigation for cyclists and e-bike riders who want to go further without guessing their range. Today we map chargers across Europe and keep expanding the continent and country route library. We’ve never lost sight of what that first hard ride taught us: elevation, weather, and charging stops belong in the plan before you leave.

about.title: the short version
about.p1: Most maps show cyclists roads. Zyflow shows them where to stop: stays, coffee stops and restaurants that welcome bikes, plus chargers, water and repair. Road closures and bike theft by area are on the map too, so riders can explore without worry.
about.p2: Zyflow is built by HERKO d.o.o. in Slovenia and launched publicly on iOS and Android in 2026.
